deadlines.notes: Applications close at 18:00 GMT, as printed on the Computer Science, Economics and Mechanical Engineering course pages.

english_policy.waiver_notes: International students must show a suitable level of English proficiency, usually through IELTS or an equivalent test, or a Presessional English course. Tests normally need to have been taken within two years of the start date. Only the most recent test score is accepted.

english.notes: Group A (Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering and most science/engineering courses): 6.0 overall with no less than 5.5 in any band. Group B (Business, including Economics, and others) needs more: Economics BSc requires 6.5 overall with 6.5 in Writing and Speaking and 6.0 in Listening and Reading.
Group A, tests taken before Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale). Economics BSc (Group B) requires 88 overall with no less than 21 in Reading, 20 in Listening, 22 in Speaking and Writing.

Group A, tests taken from Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale): 4.5 overall with no less than 4 in each skill. Economics BSc (Group B) requires 4.5 overall with no less than 4.5 in speaking and writing and 4 in reading and listening.
Group A: PTE 64 with no less than 59 in all four skills. Economics BSc (Group B): 67 overall, with 67 in Writing and Speaking and no less than 64 in Reading and Listening.
Group A: Cambridge English Advanced (exams taken from 2015), minimum overall score 169 with no less than 162 in any component. Economics BSc (Group B): 176 overall.

tier_notes.general: Complete University Guide 2027 overall ranking: 12th of 130 UK universities (A = ranks 6-15 on the national scale).
